SESSION_ID.description: WhatsApp session ID (get one from the bot's pair page)

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string — needed so settings/sessions survive restarts

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number, country code first, no + or spaces

RAPID_API_KEY.description: RapidAPI key, needed for some downloader commands

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather, used for pairing panel

RSS_LIMIT_MB.description: Memory (MB) at which the bot restarts itself cleanly before the host force-kills it. Heroku free/eco dynos have 512MB.
